commitments.description: 100% recyclable, reusable, or compostable plastic packaging by 2025.
Cut virgin plastic by one-third in packaging by 2025.

controversies.description: Toothpaste tubes traditionally combine plastic and aluminium and are very hard to recycle.

wooby.headline: Colgate is rolling out the first widely recyclable toothpaste tube.
wooby.narrative: Wooby has a fun fact: most toothpaste tubes can't be recycled. Colgate has invented a new tube that can be — and is sharing the design with other brands. Wooby thinks that is generous.
